tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Page background — warm 'auction paper' by day, graphite at night.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: vehicle cards, panels, forms, table bodies.

tokens.name: surface-300
tokens.usage: Sunken wells: spec rows, filter groups, image placeholders, hover fills.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Inverse bands: footer, compare tray, admin sidebar, loan result. Stays near-black in both themes (darker than the page at night). Text on it is `ink-inverse`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on every surface-100/200/300.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: spec labels, captions, timestamps, placeholders. ≥5.7:1 on surface-100/200 in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `surface-inverse`.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: card borders, table rules, dividers. Decorative only — never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, selects, checkboxes, secondary buttons). ≥3:1 on surface-100/200.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Harbour green — the AutoDirect colour. Primary buttons, active nav, links, selected chips, the wordmark 'Direct'.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `brand` fill.

tokens.name: brand-tint
tokens.usage: Quiet brand fills: selected rows, info panels, active filter chips. `brand` text reads on it (≥7:1).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Hanko vermilion — the auction seal. Live-auction signals, bid buttons, countdowns, auction grades. Never for errors (that is `danger`).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an `accent` fill.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Lot-tag yellow: lot numbers, 'New arrival' tags, the compare counter. Always with `ink-on-highlight` text.

tokens.name: ink-on-highlight
tokens.usage: Text on `highlight` (9.9:1).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Status text/icons: Won, Shipped, Delivered, Available. Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Status text/icons: Pending LC, Awaiting deposit, Reserved. Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Form errors, destructive admin actions, Outbid/Lost. Always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Status text/icons: In transit, Bidding, Under review.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind modal dialogs and the gallery lightbox; over photos under text.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring, offset 2px, on every interactive element (≥3:1 on all surfaces).

styles.name: display-xl
styles.sample: Bid in Tokyo. Drive in Colombo.
styles.usage: Home hero headline only. One per page.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Page titles (Our Stock, Live Auction, Compare).

styles.name: price
styles.usage: Vehicle price on detail pages and the loan result.

styles.name: heading-1
styles.usage: Section titles, vehicle name on detail page.

styles.name: heading-3
styles.usage: Vehicle card titles, form section titles.

styles.name: body-l

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Original auction sheet with English translation before every bid.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase overlines, spec labels, filter group titles.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Lot numbers, chassis codes, reference IDs, countdowns.

styles.name: mono-l
styles.usage: Live auction countdown and current bid.
